title: The Harpy Express: Viridis
description: A murder mystery social game featuring killers, civilians, and vigilantes, this Modpack is based on the Wathe: Extended Modpack.
body:
### ![The last voyage of the Harpy Express: Viridis Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d0464e49a9c025226464dd1adb7a5aa2f1489544.png)
### **🚂A train murder mystery social game**
This modpack expands **[The Last Voyage of the Harpy Express](https://modrinth.com/modpack/harpy-express)** with new roles, mechanics, customization options for the WATHE mod and its add-ons, And a **BRAND NEW MAP**


1. Host a server with the provided world.
2. Ensure the server/world has these settings:  
    -   🙏 Peaceful difficulty
    -   📜 Adventure mode
    -   ⚔️ PvP enabled
    -   🔮 Command blocks enabled.
3. Players board the train in the lobby.
4. Once 6+ players are aboard, ring the horn to begin, or wait till the timer is 0.
5. To spectate, simply stay off the train.
